inventory.analysis: Adopts and approves the Administrator report, recommendations and findings and approves the daily-newspaper code subject to conditions. The approval is expressed presently; that does not establish exhaustion of all approved code obligations. The code and Administrator report are not supplied. No held ending instrument, superseding text or independently evidenced first cessation. No whole-order end date or interval can be assigned.

Independent mandatory determination of hours and wages for news department workers, due not later than 60 days hence. No supplied evidence establishes whether or when it was made, its content, or withdrawal of this command. The deadline is not a sunset, proof of performance, or proof of continuing operative force at cutoff.

Two connected duties: government Code Authority members must give particular attention to minors delivering/selling newspapers and report to the President within 60 days. The preamble Administrator report precedes approval and is not evidence of this future report. No supplied evidence establishes performance, report delivery, discharge of the attention duty or first cessation. Neither deadline nor zero later hits proves an end.

Article VII is permitted to stand only insofar consistent with the Act; surplusage treatment is qualified by what the Act requires. Nonconsent to a future presidential modification does not affect whatever obligations Section 3(d) imposes. Assent waives no constitutional rights; expression is protected while child labor, fire safety, obscenity, libel and lewdness remain distinguished. These are interpretation/conditions/reservations, not a fresh blanket prohibition or demonstrated independent sunset. Continuing code/statutory effects and later changes cannot be adjudicated without the code and legal framework. The machine span also contains the signature and recommendation block, which add no command.
